missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Пистолет' is in the nominative case as the subject of 'лежит'. The phrase 'на столе' uses the prepositional case to show location.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Пистолет' is the inanimate accusative direct object of 'достал', identical to the nominative. 'Свой' agrees in the masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Пистолета' takes the genitive ending after 'нет' to express absence. 'У него' marks the possessor in the genitive.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Из пистолета' uses the genitive after 'из' to show the source of the shot. 'Вверх' is an adverb of direction.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'К пистолету' uses the dative after 'к' to show movement toward the object. 'Медленно' is an adverb of manner.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of accompaniment. 'С пистолетом' uses the instrumental after 'с' to show what he was carrying. 'Наготове' means at the ready.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О новом пистолете' uses the prepositional after 'о' for the topic of thought. 'Новом' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Пистолеты' is the nominative plural as the subject of 'лежат'. 'Старые' agrees in the plural, and 'в музее' shows location.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after a numeral. After 'два' the noun takes the genitive singular 'пистолета'. 'Дорогих' is the genitive plural adjective used with this numeral pattern.
Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Пистолет' is nominative as the predicate noun. 'Опасный' is the agreeing masculine adjective, intensified by 'очень'.
